title: Tessl’s Solution to Overconfident Agents | Guy Podjarny & Simon Maple
description:
What’s holding teams back from adopting agentic development at scale?

On this episode, Tessl founder & CEO Guy Podjarny and Head of DevRel Simon Maple reveal how the Tessl Framework and Spec Registry put specs at the core of AI-native engineering to overcome reliability challenges and enable scale.

On the docket:
 • why separating intent from implementation unlocks true velocity
 • how Tessl’s 10,000+ pre-built usage specs prevent API drift
 • the emergence of a dependency system for knowledge

AI Native Dev, powered by Tessl and our global dev community, is your go-to podcast for solutions in software development in the age of AI. Tune in as we engage with engineers, founders, and open-source innovators to talk all things AI, security, and development.
